same_choices: Persistent saved state is carried by a non-color structural/pose change (corner dog-ear fold vs held ~12deg tilt), NOT a fill or color swap; both explicitly reject color as the saved cue and both persist after the animation and after hover leaves.
Snappy sub-200ms motion built on an overshoot (01 ~180ms scale-pop with fast overshoot, 02 ~150ms anticipation-then-snap with one damped overshoot) — same quick, physical, springy timing character.

Motion is anchored at the bottom edge of the button — 01 originates its scale from the bookmark notch (bottom V) 'pressing down into the toolbar', 03 anchors the unfurl/retract at the bottom-edge 'pocket'; a user sees motion tied to the bottom in both.

A transient, momentary confirmation flourish fires at the commit instant on top of the state change (checkmark stamp punch that lifts vs a single radial haptic-style pulse ring), and both include a brief scale bump at that moment.

Confirmation uses a faux-haptic / haptic-style pulse cue as the commit feel (02's entire feedback modality is a faux-haptic micro-bounce; 03 adds an explicit visual haptic-style pulse that mimics a haptic tick at the latch).
Bright yellow-green accent on a dark surface — lime #C6FF3D (02) and chartreuse #C8F03C (03) are near-identical hues, over charcoal (#1B1B1E) / deep plum (#3B1F4B).
